fullPassage: There is a reason the title "Monday Morning Quarterback" exists. Just read the comments on social media from fans discussing the weekend's games, and you quickly see how many people believe they could play, coach, and manage sport teams more successfully than those on the field. This goes for the boardroom as well. Students and professionals with years of training and specialized degrees in sport business may also find themselves being given advice on how to do their jobs from friends, family, or even total strangers without any expertise. Executives in sport management have decades of knowledge and experience in their respective fields. However, many of them face criticism from fans and community members telling them how to run their business. Very few people tell their doctor how to perform surgery or their accountant how to prepare their taxes, but many people provide feedback on how sport organizations should be managed.

Just read the comments on social media from fans discussing the weekend's games, and you quickly see how many people believe they could play, coach, and manage sport teams more successfully than those on the field. This goes for the boardroom as well. Students and professionals with years of training and specialized degrees in sport business may also find themselves being given advice on how to do their jobs from friends, family, or even total strangers without any expertise. Executives in sport management have decades of knowledge and experience in their respective fields. However, many of them face criticism from fans and community members telling them __________. Very few people tell their doctor how to perform surgery or their accountant how to prepare their taxes, but many people provide feedback on how sport organizations should be managed.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 how to run their business(그들의 사업을 운영하는 방법)가 적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① when to retire from sports(언제 은퇴할지): 문맥 부적합
❌ ② why their team lost again(왜 또 졌는지): 문맥 부적합
❌ ③ where to invest their money(돈을 어디에 투자할지): 문맥 부적합
✅ ④ how to run their business(사업을 운영하는 방법): 'face criticism ... telling them __________' — 팬·지역민이 임원에게 사업 운영 방식을 지적 ← 정답
det.tip: tell + 목적어 + how to ~ = ~에게 ~하는 방법을 말하다
